record.paper_title: Introduction to the Yang-Baxter Equation with Open Problems
record.original_question: Classify all solutions of the Yang-Baxter equation in the braid-relation form: for a vector space V over an algebraically closed field k of characteristic zero, determine all linear automorphisms R of V tensor V satisfying (R tensor id) o (id tensor R) o (R tensor id) = (id tensor R) o (R tensor id) o (id tensor R) as automorphisms of V tensor V tensor V.

evidence.quote: Finding all solutions of the Yang-Baxter equation is a difficult task far from being resolved.
However, the full classification of its solutions remains an open problem.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, and let $V$ be a vector space over $k$. A linear automorphism $R\colon V\otimes V \to V\otimes V$ is called a (braided) solution of the Yang-Baxter equation if it satisfies the braid relation
$$(R\otimes \mathrm{id}_V)\circ(\mathrm{id}_V\otimes R)\circ(R\otimes \mathrm{id}_V) \;=\; (\mathrm{id}_V\otimes R)\circ(R\otimes \mathrm{id}_V)\circ(\mathrm{id}_V\otimes R)$$
as automorphisms of $V\otimes V\otimes V$.

Problem. Classify, up to a suitable notion of equivalence (e.g. conjugation by $A\otimes A$ for $A\in \mathrm{GL}(V)$), all such linear automorphisms $R$ of $V\otimes V$. Equivalently, give a complete description of all braided solutions of the Yang-Baxter equation on an arbitrary finite-dimensional vector space $V$ over $k$.
artifact.status_search_result: The full classification of solutions of the Yang-Baxter equation in braid form remains an open problem. While numerous partial results exist (e.g., classifications for $\dim V = 2$ by Hietarinta, set-theoretic solutions via braces by Rump, Etingof-Schedler-Soloviev, and others), a complete classification in general dimension is widely acknowledged as unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Introduction to the Yang-Baxter Equation with Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Finding all solutions of the Yang-Baxter equation is a difficult task far from being resolved.
status_evidence.claim: The general classification of YBE solutions is open.

status_evidence.title: Set-theoretical solutions to the quantum Yang-Baxter equation (Etingof-Schedler-Soloviev)
status_evidence.snippet: We study set-theoretic solutions of the quantum Yang-Baxter equation; classification is obtained only in special cases.
status_evidence.claim: Even the set-theoretic case is only partially classified.
